meta.name: Pakistan Sahulat AI — knowledge base
meta.note: Unofficial concept demo. Summaries are process overviews; fees/rules change — always confirm on the linked official site.

services.summary: Expired/gumshuda CNIC renew karne ke 2 tareeqay: (1) Pak-ID mobile app se online apply karo — photo, fingerprints aur fee online; card ghar par TCS se aata hai. (2) Qareebi NADRA centre jao — token lo, biometrics do, slip lo. Normal/urgent/executive categories hoti hain, fee category par depend karti hai.
services.title: CNIC Renew (NADRA)

services.summary: Overseas Pakistanis NICOP Pak-ID app ya NADRA website se online apply kar sakte hain — passport-size photo, passport copy aur fee online. Card courier se milta hai. Renewal bhi online hota hai.
services.title: NICOP (Overseas Pakistanis)

services.summary: FRC (family tree certificate) Pak-ID app ya NADRA centre se banta hai. Family members ke CNIC numbers darkar hote hain. Fees aur delivery time official site par check karo.
services.title: Family Registration Certificate (FRC)

services.summary: Passport DGIP ke online portal se apply hota hai: account banao, form bharo, fee bank/app se jama karo, phir qareebi passport office me biometrics + photo. Normal/urgent categories; fee pages/saala par depend karti hai — official fee schedule site par hai.
services.title: Passport Renew / New (DGIP)

services.summary: Apne passport application ka status DGIP website ke tracking section me token number se check karo. SMS alerts bhi aate hain.
services.title: Passport Tracking

services.summary: Apna CNIC number (bina dashes) 8171 par SMS karo — eligibility/payment ka jawab aata hai. Ya 8171.bisp.gov.pk par CNIC daal kar online check karo. Kisi ko paise/OTP mat do — 8171 sarkari hai, free hai.
services.title: 8171 — BISP Payment Check

services.summary: Apna CNIC number 8300 par SMS karo — voter registration, halqa aur polling station ka jawab milta hai. Tafseel ECP website par.
services.title: Vote Check (ECP 8300)

services.summary: Punjab me pehle learner permit (DLIMS portal ya khidmat centre), phir 42 din baad permanent license ka test (theory + road). Fee aur required documents DLIMS portal par hain.
services.title: Driving License — Punjab

services.summary: Sindh me license Traffic Police ke Driving License branches se banta hai — learner, phir test. Online appointment/schedule Sindh Police ki site par check karo.
services.title: Driving License — Sindh

services.summary: Filer banne ke liye FBR Iris portal par NTN register karo, phir annual income tax return file karo — return file hone par naam Active Taxpayer List (ATL) me aata hai. ATL status FBR site par CNIC se check hota hai.
services.title: Filer / Active Taxpayer (FBR)

services.summary: Bache ka birth certificate mutaliqa Union Council se banta hai — hospital ka birth slip aur waliden ke CNIC darkar hote hain. Uske baad NADRA se B-Form (CRC) banta hai.
services.title: Birth Certificate (Union Council)

services.summary: Domicile/PRC zila ke Deputy Commissioner office se banta hai — application form, CNIC, walid ka domicile, photos aur affidavit darkar hote hain. Koi single national portal nahi; apne zila DC office se rabta karo.
services.title: Domicile / PRC

services.summary: Emergency: 15 milao. Online complaint Punjab me Police Khidmat Markaz portal par, Sindh me Sindh Police ki site/app par darj hoti hai. FIR ki copy lena tumhara haq hai — thane se receipt zaroor lo.
services.title: FIR / Police Complaint

services.summary: K-Electric ka bill account number se KE website/app par check aur pay hota hai. Duplicate bill bhi wahan se nikalta hai. Load-shedding schedule bhi app par hota hai.
services.title: KE Bill Check (Karachi)
